d: Behind every extraordinary cake is hours of creativity, patience and hard work. Join Buddy Valastro and the team at Carlo's Bakery as they take on challenging custom orders, bring imaginative cake designs to life and finally reveal their creations to delighted customers. From elaborate themed cakes to unique designs, the best part is seeing every bit of effort pay off. Watch Cake Boss Season 6 Episodes 19, 4, 8, 9, 3, 10, 13 and 14 only on discovery+ India.
